facts.claim: 凯带“我”打开那间无窗建筑，发现里面是丹的运动器材棚，堆满赛自行车、滑雪装备、帐篷和杠铃片。
facts.quote: I saw a ton of skiing and snowboarding equipment lurking in the back

facts.claim: 前往门卫岗亭的路上，凯一路闲聊家常，说自己有一儿一女，八岁的Ezra Junior和一岁半的LaKayla。
facts.quote: “Ezra Junior is eight. I know, big gaps! My attempt to hold on to my career.”

facts.claim: 到了岗亭外，凯介绍围栏另一侧的年轻警员Jeffrey，说他是圣约瑟夫警察局最年轻的警佐。
facts.quote: “That’s Jeffrey,” said Kay. “Youngest sergeant in the SJPD.”

facts.claim: 凯告知“我”：已联系上Deirdre的Uber司机，证实她被送到La Dorada Inn and Suites旅馆。
facts.quote: dropped her off at the La Dorada Inn and Suites

facts.claim: 保安Alberto接受凯的问询，说Deirdre当晚没有回来过，但Caraway太太凌晨两点多独自开车外出。
facts.quote: He took a moment to consider the question. “A little after two in the morning.”

facts.claim: Alberto形容Genevieve两次经过岗亭时都很疲惫、不笑、几乎不看他，而且她以前从未半夜外出。
facts.quote: “No smile. She hardly looked at me when I opened the gate, both times.”

facts.claim: 凯追问围栏电网，Alberto承认有一块面板接触不良会断电，但他刚用电压表测过，现在一切正常。
facts.quote: We control it in the guard station. It stays on all the time. Day and night.

facts.claim: “我”最后问Alberto是否检查过Genevieve的车，得知只查客人不查住户，她的车可能藏有秘密。
facts.quote: Genevieve’s car could have been harboring any number of secrets

relations.rel: 夫妻（她抱怨丈夫不运动、胆固醇高）
relations.quote: I wish my Ezra would exercise more. He’s an electrical engineer, a real smarty-pants.

relations.rel: 母女（女儿十八个月，坐后向婴儿座）
保安与住户（他两次为她开闸，彼此点头）
relations.quote: “We did not speak. I nodded at her both times, and she nodded back.”

relations.rel: 警探与受访保安（在车内做笔录问询）
relations.quote: “My first question,” said Kay, “is whether Deirdre Gregory ever came back at any point, later in the evening?”

relations.rel: 同行调查者（她是警探，我是代笔人，同车走访）
relations.quote: She’d already said I was easy to talk to, and to my surprise, I found this went both ways.

numbers.quote: the morning shift from six till two
it had to be close to ninety degrees

numbers.claim: 棚内细轮赛车的数量下限
numbers.quote: at least two dozen of those thin-wheeled racing bikes

numbers.value: A little after two in the morning
numbers.quote: “A little after two in the morning.”
“So she was gone for just under two hours?”

numbers.claim: Uber从庄园开到旅馆的时长
numbers.quote: about ten minutes after leaving here

numbers.claim: 叙述者自嘲错过的热瑜伽课已开课时间
叙述者觉得三个孩子很多（凯反驳说在这乡下不算什么）
numbers.quote: Three sounds like a lot to me.

turning_point: 保安Alberto的证词把怀疑对象从“外来闯入者”转向Genevieve本人：她凌晨两点多独自外出、近四点才回，且她的车从未被检查过，于是凯与“我”立刻动身去当面问她。
notes: 本章“我”即叙述者（Genevieve的代笔人），无姓名；Alberto全名Nunez；Jeffrey为SJPD最年轻警佐；Gwen与Ernesto仅一带而过的门卫班次，未展开。
